sectionConfigSyncDesc:
Prerequisite: enable SiYuan official cloud sync or S3 sync first, otherwise this feature will not work.

Syncs: app config only. Themes live in the data folder and are synced by SiYuan itself; this feature no longer copies them.

How it works: calls Export Settings in Settings → About, copies that pack into data\storage\petal\cursorart-tools\config-sync, then runs SiYuan sync. Overwrite syncs first as a cloud baseline, rebuilds the cache, records the valid file list, then uploads. Download only syncs and does not wipe the cache first, so an empty folder is not pushed to the cloud.

How to use:
1. On device A, click “Overwrite cloud config” and wait until sync finishes.
2. On device B, click “Download cloud config” and wait until sync finishes.
3. When prompted to restart, restart.

imageScaleEnableDesc: Apply to all images using system DPI: fixed px when DPI width is below editor content width, calc(100% - 8px) otherwise; refreshes on resize (including manually adjusted images).
imageScaleCenterDesc: Injects global CSS: .p:has(span.img) { margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; } without changing block attributes.
autoDpiCompensatedLabel: System DPI: ${dpi} (${percent}%). Siyuan UI zoom ${appZoomPercent}% excluded (devicePixelRatio ${rawPercent}%).
autoDpiUnavailable: Cannot read system DPI; image scaling is unavailable.
panguSpacingEnable: Auto space between CJK and Latin
panguSpacingEnableDesc: Real-time spacing in the DOM while typing; paste is normalized via textPlain, textHTML, and siyuanHTML before render. Spaces around inline code stay outside the code mark. Skips IME composition, code blocks, and title blocks.
docRefStyleEnableDesc: Show document icon, bold text, and underline only on auto-inserted child-nav refs. Manual refs are unchanged; nothing is written into the document body.
sectionDefaultIconsDesc: Applies only to notebooks and documents that have no custom icon. Click the icon to use SiYuan’s picker; Restore returns the official default. If SiYuan’s file-tree setting “Use SVG as default icons” is on, the tree uses official SVGs and these emoji defaults do not apply.
sectionDefaultIconsDescSvg: SiYuan’s “Use SVG as default icons” is on: the file tree and untitled/no-icon document refs use official SVGs, so the emoji defaults below are inactive. Turn that setting off to customize default emojis.
defaultIconSvgActiveHint: SiYuan is using SVG default icons. To customize default emojis, turn off “Use SVG as default icons” in Settings → File tree.
defaultIconNotebookDesc: Default icon for notebooks in the file tree.
defaultIconFolderDesc: Default icon when a document has sub-documents.
defaultIconFileDesc: Default icon when a document has no sub-documents.
defaultIconPickerUnavailable: This SiYuan version does not expose the icon picker. Please upgrade.
